problem: An external API review was designed from scratch across two proposal versions while an operated implementation existed in the LLMGP project. Its location was not hidden: the source record fixed at 2026-08-02 names the absolute paths and digests, and that record was read during this session. What was taken from it was only the adoption list, so the review assets went unnoticed. The proposal therefore invented a payload shape, an approval granularity and a ceiling of twenty groups, none of which were checked against a mechanism that had already been run six times over four days.
impact: the egress proposal rests on invented parameters rather than on operated experience
the masked target form and the criteria documents answer, in practice, the question the proposal was trying to design
this is the fifth background gap in one session, and the first where the location was recorded in advance and still not consulted
the pre-proposal check section added earlier today did not catch it, because the check surveyed the current repository rather than the sources the records point to
boundary: preserve this observation as immutable source
do not treat this observation as an Improvement Candidate, Human Triage Decision or Issue Record
no LLMGP artefact was copied into this repository; only directory and file names were read
the contents of the review runs have not been analysed, so what should be inherited is not yet determined
